Does implantation site influence bone ingrowth into 3D-printed porous implants?

Medium AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Direct Save for project animal Exp. validation
William R Walsh, Matthew H Pelletier, Tian Wang, Vedran Lovric, Per Morberg et al. The spine journal : official journal of the North American Spine Society 2019-11-01 10.1016/j.spinee.2019.06.020
单位: Surgical and Orthopaedic Research Laboratories (SORL), Prince of Wales Clinical School, University of New South Wales, Sydney, Australia; NeuroSpine Surgery Research Group (NSURG), Sydney, Australia.
通讯: William R Walsh @ Surgical and Orthopaedic Research Laboratories (SORL), Prince of Wales Clinical School, University of New South Wales, S
相关性: 该论文直接研究了3D打印多孔植入物的骨整合，与用户关注的骨整合方向高度相关。
边界: Does not explicitly link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, and lacks fatigue testing and surface roughness characterization.
动机· 研究植入部位对3D打印多孔植入物骨长入的影响。
方法· 在羊的皮质骨、松质骨和腰椎融合模型中植入相同设计的3D打印钛合金植入物，进行影像学、力学和组织学评估。
结果· 皮质骨中骨长入良好且随时间改善，但松质骨和椎间融合器中骨长入较差，主要填充纤维血管组织。
验证· 动物实验验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the influence of anatomical site on osseointegration of 3D-printed porous implants.
Method· Implantation of 3D-printed titanium alloy dowels and interbody cages in sheep cortical, cancellous, and lumbar fusion sites, assessed by radiography, mechanical testing, and histology.
Result· Bone ingrowth in cortical sites was robust and increased over time, but cancellous and interbody sites showed limited osseointegration with fibrovascular tissue filling.
Validation· Preclinical animal study (sheep).

Result· The coating exhibited antibacterial activity via micro-galvanic effects reducing ATP and increasing ROS, and promoted osseointegration by upregulating bone-forming proteins.
Validation· In vitro antibacterial assays and in vivo animal implantation with histological analysis.

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark UQ
Vu Nguyen, Sunil Gupta, Santu Rana, My T. Thai, Cheng Li et al. 2019-11-01 10.1109/icdm.2019.00159
单位: University of Oxford
通讯: Vu Nguyen @ University of Oxford
相关性: 该论文提出了一种高效的贝叶斯优化方法，可应用于植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
边界: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or biomechanical implant design; it focuses on general Bayesian optimization for uncertainty reduction.
动机· 提高贝叶斯优化效率，避免近似计算带来的性能损失。
方法· 提出预测方差缩减搜索（PVRS），通过闭式解直接减少感知最优位置的不确定性。
结果· PVRS在标准与批量设置下均显著加速优化，且保持良好优化性能。
验证· 在基准函数和实际应用上验证了方法的有效性与效率。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To improve the efficiency of Bayesian optimization by avoiding expensive approximations in predictive entropy search.
Method· Proposes predictive variance reduction search (PVRS) that selects points to maximally reduce uncertainty at perceived optima locations, with a closed-form acquisition function.
Result· PVRS achieves substantial speedup over PES while maintaining competitive optimization performance in both standard and batch settings.
Validation· Validated on synthetic benchmark functions and real-world applications, demonstrating efficiency and effectiveness.

Liu Yang, Sean Treichler, Thorsten Kurth, Keno Fischer, David A. Barajas‐Solano et al. 2019-11-01 10.1109/dls49591.2019.00006
单位: Brown University, USA
通讯: Liu Yang @ Brown University, USA
相关性: 该论文展示了物理信息生成对抗网络在随机偏微分方程不确定性量化中的可扩展性，其方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的高效采样与不确定性量化。
边界: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, nor does it handle constrained optimization or surrogate modeling for finite element analysis.
动机· 解决地下流动问题中随机偏微分方程的不确定性量化挑战。
方法· 开发高度可扩展的物理信息生成对抗网络，采用层次化多玩家博弈方法实现领域并行。

Motivation· To address the challenge of uncertainty quantification for forward and inverse problems in subsurface flow modeling at the Hanford Site.
Method· Developed a highly scalable physics-informed generative adversarial network (GAN) using a hierarchical multi-player game-theoretic approach for domain parallelism on thousands of GPUs.
Result· Achieved 93.1% scaling efficiency on 4584 nodes of the Summit supercomputer, with peak and sustained half-precision rates of 1228 PF/s and 1207 PF/s.
Validation· Validated through simulation of subsurface flow at the Hanford Site, demonstrating scalability and convergence.

Motivation· To improve the homogeneity of calcium phosphate cement mixtures for extrusion-based 3D printing, reducing clogging and inconsistent mechanical properties.
Method· A planetary centrifugal mixer was used to blend powder-powder and powder-liquid compounds, and homogeneity was evaluated using ImageJ image analysis.
Result· Centrifugal accelerations of 16G and 66G achieved homogeneous mixing within 3 minutes for the tested compounds.
Validation· Homogeneity was validated through image analysis of colored mixtures.

Motivation· To develop a scaffold that promotes osseointegration and overcomes limitations of autograft for vertical bone augmentation.
Method· A nanocomposite fibrous scaffold (silica-coated nanoHA-gelatin reinforced with electrospun PLLA nanoyarns) was fabricated and implanted in rabbit mandibular defects using staged or simultaneous dental implantation.

Motivation· To tune controller parameters online without interrupting normal plant operation, using only historical data and ensuring safety.

Validation· The neural network model is trained on historical measurement data and used as a surrogate to evaluate controller performance in simulation.

Motivation· To develop novel titanium alloys with low Young's modulus to mitigate stress shielding in orthopaedic implants.

Result· Ti-33Nb-7Zr exhibits the lowest Young's modulus of 29.0 GPa, attributed to increased β-phase stability, while Ti-23Nb-7Zr has the highest modulus of 35.9 GPa due to α' phase.
Validation· Validation was performed through nanoindentation measurements and X-ray diffraction phase identification.

Jafri Hasan Orthopaedic Journal of Sports Medicine 2019-11-01 10.1177/2325967119s00462
单位: Department of Orthopedic and Traumatology, Tarakan Hospital, Jakarta, Indonesia
通讯: Jafri Hasan @ Department of Orthopedic and Traumatology, Tarakan Hospital, Jakarta, Indonesia
相关性: 该论文关注半月板根部修复，与髋关节植入物和股骨柄的应力遮挡、微动及有限元分析无关。
边界: This paper does not quantify proximal femur stress/strain in Gruen zones, does not report micromotion with contact/friction modeling, is not patient-specific or population-based for hip implants, and does not compare intact vs implanted femur.
动机· 半月板根部撕裂若不治疗会导致骨关节炎。
方法· 综述了经胫骨拉出修复和锚钉修复两种技术。
结果· 锚钉修复生物力学更好，经胫骨修复存在蹦极效应。
验证· 无实验验证，为文献综述。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Meniscal root tears, if untreated, lead to early osteoarthritis due to compromised hoop stress and increased contact pressures.
Method· This review compares trans-tibial pullout repair and suture anchor repair techniques for meniscal root tears.
Result· Suture anchor repair shows better biomechanical outcomes, while trans-tibial pullout repair suffers from a 'bungee effect' and displacement under cyclic loading.
Validation· No experimental validation; the paper is a narrative review of existing literature.
